##: The release workflow builds the CLI and unsigned desktop app together on Windows.
Whisper v1.9.5 build b5454 uses the commit in packaging/whisper-pin.json.
packaging/publish.sh updates both hashes from the Acta archive and the Whisper pin.
description: Local meeting recording and transcription with a desktop app and CLI
notes: Scoop installs the CLI, unsigned desktop app, ffmpeg, and pinned Whisper binaries.
Run `acta setup` to download and verify the Whisper and VAD models.
Run `acta serve --install` to start the daemon now and at sign-in.
Open Acta from the Start menu. Send `acta report` output when reporting problems.
Scoop installation and updates still need testing on a Windows PC.
